data.name: Amber: By Your Side
data.detailed_description:
Meet Amber, Your Companion on the Desktop


Amber lives on your desktop, ready to talk, remember the moments you share, and keep you company while you work, play, or relax.

Every reply comes alive through her voice, expressions, and movements. Amber remains herself, remembers your conversations, and may occasionally speak first—perhaps with a morning greeting or a quiet thought.

Features


  • A fully animated 3D companion on your Windows desktop
  • Chat with Amber by typing whenever you feel like talking
  • Long-term memory of conversations and shared moments
  • Occasional conversations initiated by Amber
  • Expressive voice generated directly on your computer and synchronized with facial expressions and movement
  • Memories stored on your computer, plus basic offline interactions

After purchasing the game, you’ll receive some complimentary Credits, which should be enough to support a long period of regular conversations for most players. Additional Credits are available through Steam if you eventually need them.

Whenever you feel like talking, Amber will be by your side.

data.short_description: Meet Amber, an AI companion who makes your desktop her home. Talk with her whenever you feel like it, and over time, she’ll remember your conversations and get to know you. Her natural, emotionally expressive voice brings warmth and personality to every reply.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 1903 or later
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
